blurb:
Embark on a private, personable journey through Victoria, followed by a visit to the world-renowned Butchart Gardens located just 40 minutes from the city. 

Stroll through Fisherman’s Wharf, a vibrant community of colourful floating homes and food kiosks. Wander the charming Inner Harbour, framed by elegant historic buildings and scenic waterfront views.

Visit Canada’s oldest Chinatown and take a stroll through the iconic Fan Tan Alley.

Explore the magnificent Butchart Gardens at your own pace, taking in the breathtaking Sunken Garden, the striking water fountain, the seasonal Rose Garden, and the serene Japanese and elegant Italian Gardens.

After your garden exploration will take a drive through Victoria’s picturesque neighbourhoods, including photo stops at the exterior of Craigdarroch Castle and Government House—the residence used by the Royal Family during visits.
